item.title: 50 years of Safety Science Anniversary
item.content:encoded:
This special issue marks the 50th anniversary of Safety Science journal. The issue invites contributions that reflect on the journal's impact and trajectory over five decades, as well as explore emerging directions in safety research and practice.

Appel publié par Safety Science. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Safety science evolution and history
  • Future directions in safety research
  • Safety management and organizational practices
  • Occupational health and safety
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Safety culture and human factors
  • Industrial safety
  • Emergency management and disaster prevention

Timeline

  • March 1, 2027: Submission deadline
